text:
chao: noticing elevated GPU pending pods in eu-west1 since ~08:02 UTC, autoscaler not reacting

maria: saw that, dashboard metrics for pod_scheduling_latency are blank around the same time :confused:

alex: looks like otel-collector in eu-west1 terraform group restarted and crashed, collecting no metrics for ~6m per cluster logs

chao: hmm that aligns. autoscaler relies on custom exporter `redwood-infra/gpu-util-exporter` which scrapes otel backend for node-level GPU metrics

maria: can we confirm exporter scrape errors? I have a snippet from the node that lost metrics:
```
time="2027-05-12T08:03:12Z" level=error msg="fetching metrics" err="rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection closed"
```

alex: yep that rpc error repeated; collector crashed due to OOM while processing a high-cardinality trace spike during a regional model rollout

chao: consequence: HPA/autoscaler and fleet scheduler couldn't see real GPU utilization -> they didn't scale or rebalance -> pending pods piled up

jun: immediate mitigation I propose: (1) divert new host-routing to us-west2 for heavy model variants (2) bump dedicated eu-west1 reserved pool by 8 gpus manually (3) kill the collector pods to force restart with lower batch size config

maria: +1 for collector config change. also we should enable the fallback metric we discussed in last-week runbook: emit node-level `node.gpu.heartbeat` from kubelet sidecar when exporter/tailers fail

chao: can someone run the reroute command for traffic shifting? I can do the collector restart. alex can handle dedicated pool bump?

alex: on it. Scaling dedicated pool now:
```
# manual scale command to dedicated pool
redwoodctl pools scale --region eu-west1 --pool reserved-gpu-heavy --gpus 8
```
I see it queued, ETA ~4m for new nodes to join.

jun: reroute done for the major model routes: `models/resnet-768:traffic=region=eu-west1->us-west2:20%` via router API

ops-bot: deploy event: route-update applied by jun at 2027-05-12T08:12:34Z :white_check_mark:

maria: collector restart in progress. I'll push a temp config to reduce batch_size and enable `emit_heartbeat_on_error: true` on exporter sidecar

chao: after restart, check Prometheus scrape logs and autoscaler decision logs. If metrics still absent, we fallback to scheduled drain of low-priority pods and preempt via eviction policy

alex: dedicated nodes are in. kubelet reports GPUs ready on 4 new nodes. Starting to schedule backlog. But autoscaler decisions still delayed until metrics flow back in

maria: collector back up at 08:17 UTC. logs show previous OOMKilled. New config applied: `batch_max=128 -> 32`, `emit_heartbeat_on_error=true`. Exporter now reports heartbeat lines:
```
node.gpu.heartbeat 1 host="ip-10-2-14-33" 172789
```

chao: great. Prometheus scrapes resumed, HPA recalculated and pods started to move. backlog reduced from ~112 pending to ~18 in ~6m

jun: post-incident note: we need two followups
- add a short-circuit metric path: exporter should push to a dedicated lightweight pushgateway when otel is unavailable
- increase otel-collector memory limit and add vertical probe to detect trace surges early

alex: also recommend we add autoscaler's fallback to use `node.gpu.heartbeat` when primary GPU metrics are stale for >30s. Should be a small change in the scaler controller config

maria: opened infra ticket INF-2027-114: "eu-west1 otel OOM -> missing GPU metrics -> autoscaler blindspot" with proposed PR links and runbook updates

ops-bot: ticket INF-2027-114 created by maria: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2027-114

chao: one more ops-level tweak: for the next 72h we'll run conservative routing policy to cap eu-west1 serving to 60% of normal for heavy models to avoid repeat saturation

jun: agreed. cost note: expected extra cross-region egress ~2.3TB and 12 hours of extra reserved nodes -> approx $4.2k additional spend for incident containment (estimated)

alex: monitoring: I've added an alert that fires when `prometheus_target_scrapes_failed[5m] > 3` for exporter components and page on-call if so

maria: adding a unit test in exporter repo to simulate otel drop and ensure heartbeat emission works

chao: thanks team. update the runbook: add `emit_heartbeat_on_error` as a required safeguard and document manual reroute steps under "regional saturation"

jun: closing loop: by 08:28 UTC we were back to healthy thresholds, no customer-facing rate-limit triggers, will run a 24h watch

sre-runbook-bot: follow-up reminder scheduled: review INF-2027-114 in 48h

alex: thanks all, good coordination. we'll reconvene if anything spikes. :metal:
